options.name: name
options.description: The name of the feature to manage. Run C(choco.exe feature list) to get a list of features that can be managed. For a list of options see L(Chocolatey feature docs,https://chocolatey.org/docs/chocolatey-configuration#features)

options.name: state
options.description: When C(disabled) then the feature will be disabled. When C(enabled) then the feature will be enabled.
